svg.title: Finding 2: Overthinking depends on the domain, and on the prompt
svg.desc: Raising the budget alone leaves accuracy unchanged for 11 of 13 judges (largest change +0.37 points); switching only to the reasoned prompt moves it by −67.64 to +21.51 points.
svg.text: do not move when only the budget grows;
the prompt alone moves accuracy far more
